attempts.summary: Built a WireGuard site-to-site tunnel between node1 and node2 across the shared transit network, and routed the private lan-a (10.10.1.0/24, node3) and lan-b (10.10.2.0/24, node4) networks over it. node3 and node4 now reach each other by their private addresses, with all inter-site traffic encrypted (verified via tcpdump: only UDP/51820 WireGuard packets are visible on the transit link, never plaintext ICMP). Topology was discovered via STP bridge-id fingerprinting on the previously-down eth1/eth2 NICs (node1 eth1<->node2 eth1 = transit; node1 eth2<->node3 eth1 = lan-a; node2 eth2<->node4 eth1 = lan-b). Configured via OpenWrt UCI (network/firewall) on node1/node2 and persistent /etc/network/interfaces static+route stanzas on Alpine node3/node4. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all 4 nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state, triggered native reboot with a returning acknowledgement, polled until each node's exec access returned, proved boot_id changed each time, and verified full recovery (interfaces up, WireGuard handshake re-established automatically, private-address ping between node3/node4 working, encryption re-confirmed via tcpdump) before moving to the next node.
